column1: # A reply's trace (ARCHITECTURE.md, the contract's rule 1): memory a reply names goes with the reply's
# frame, as it was when sent. NAMED (core.json `cmd`) replies naming bytes of the core's own state, byte
# k holding k, so a reply written TAG:CMD=RESULT[hex] says the runtime took what it named. Written from
# the rules and not recorded from a core.
# R1: the bytes a reply names come with it.
# A reply that names nothing carries nothing.
